11.name: Sealing Wax
11.why: A seal pressed hard and bold enough to mean it.

11.name: Lingonberry
11.why: Tart and wild, a berry that dares you to taste it.

11.name: Tusheti Fire
11.why: The fire kept burning through the highland winter, wild and warm.

12.name: Campfire
12.why: A campfire at dusk, wild and warm, that pulls you in close.

12.name: Kiln Glow
12.why: A little dangerous and warm all the way through, like the glow of a kiln at night.

12.name: Qvevri
12.why: The clay jars Georgia has buried its wine in for thousands of years, fierce and kind.
